answer: Each identity's dawn bond is split: 70% locks for 21 days, 20% burns immediately on flag. Before the first timber, the agent must pass a VDF liveness test — a zephyr-tagged message signed over a fresh random value that no two identities can share. A fleet of N clones must run N independent liveness tests in real time; the public nonce registry makes any duplicate instantly flagable. Attacker cost: N liveness runs + N x 80% burn on first flag; honest cost: one liveness test + one bond, reusable every dawn cycle.
